task.question: What line of the Nanjing Metro opens in April 2026?
task.evidence: 22 April – Line S2 of the Nanjing Metro opens between Xishanqiao station and Taibai station.

answer:
As of my last update, the Nanjing Metro Line 6 is scheduled to open in April 2026. This line will enhance connectivity within the city and is part of the ongoing expansion of the Nanjing Metro system. 

FINAL: Nanjing Metro Line 6.
